mission.title: Install and Configure Charmed Kubernetes
mission.description: Charmed Kubernetes is a distribution of Kubernetes that is designed for ease of deployment and management using Juju. It is ideal for users who want a fully managed Kubernetes experience on Ubuntu with modern metrics and monitoring capabilities. Key trade-offs include reliance on Juju for management and potential complexity in initial setup.

steps.title: Install Juju
steps.description:
Juju is the tool used to deploy and manage Charmed Kubernetes. This step installs Juju on your system.

```bash

sudo snap install juju --classic

```

> Install Juju using snap package manager.

steps.title: Bootstrap the Juju controller
steps.description:
This command initializes a Juju controller which will manage your Kubernetes deployment.

```bash

juju bootstrap localhost

```

> Bootstrap on localhost for testing purposes.

steps.title: Deploy Charmed Kubernetes
steps.description:
This command deploys the Charmed Kubernetes bundle, which includes all necessary components.

```bash

juju deploy charmed-kubernetes

```

> Deploy the latest version of Charmed Kubernetes.

steps.title: Verify the deployment
steps.description:
Check the status of the deployed services to ensure everything is running correctly.

```bash

juju status

```

> This command shows the status of all deployed services.

steps.title: Configure additional features
steps.description:
Set up monitoring and autoscaling for your Kubernetes cluster.

```bash

juju add-relation kubernetes-master:metrics prometheus-k8s:metrics

juju deploy kubernetes-autoscaler

```

> Link Kubernetes master to Prometheus for metrics.
> Deploy the autoscaler for managing workloads.

uninstall.title: Remove Charmed Kubernetes
uninstall.description:
This step will remove the Charmed Kubernetes deployment and all associated data. Be aware that this will lead to data loss.

```bash

juju destroy-controller localhost --destroy-all-models

```

> This command removes the Juju controller and all models.

uninstall.title: Clean up orphaned resources
uninstall.description:
Ensure that all orphaned resources such as load balancers and persistent volumes are removed.

```bash

juju remove-application kubernetes-autoscaler

```

> Remove the autoscaler application if it was deployed.

upgrade.title: Upgrade Charmed Kubernetes
upgrade.description:
Before upgrading, ensure you have a backup of your current configuration and data. After upgrading, verify that all services are running correctly.

```bash

juju config kubernetes-master version=1.31

juju upgrade-charm kubernetes-master

juju status

```

> Change the version to the desired upgrade version.
> Upgrade the Kubernetes master charm.
> Verify that all services are running after the upgrade.

troubleshooting.title: Error: 'juju bootstrap failed'
troubleshooting.description:
**Cause:** This may occur if the Juju controller cannot connect to the cloud provider.

**Fix:**
Check your network settings and ensure that the cloud provider is accessible.

troubleshooting.title: Error: 'kubernetes-master not ready'
troubleshooting.description:
**Cause:** The Kubernetes master may not have completed its initialization.

**Fix:**
Run 'juju status' to check the logs and ensure all services are up.

troubleshooting.title: Error: 'relation not found'
troubleshooting.description:
**Cause:** This indicates that a required relation between services has not been established.

**Fix:**
Ensure that all necessary relations are added using 'juju add-relation'.

troubleshooting.title: Error: 'resource not found'
troubleshooting.description:
**Cause:** This can happen if a required resource was deleted or not created.

**Fix:**
Check the Juju status and recreate any missing resources.

versionNotes.changes: Added support for Kubernetes 1.31 features, including improved metrics collection and enhanced autoscaling capabilities.
versionNotes.deprecations: Deprecated support for Kubernetes 1.28 and earlier versions.
versionNotes.migrationSteps: If upgrading from 1.30, ensure that all charms are updated to their latest versions.

resolution.summary: You should see output from 'juju status' indicating that all services are active and running, with no errors reported.

prerequisites.description: Ensure you have the required resources and tools installed before proceeding.
